typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		CLIENT_NBR as string,
		TRANSACTION_DT as timestamp,
		TRANS_ACCT_HIST_CD as string,
		TRADE_DT as timestamp,
		TAG_TRAN_CD as string,
		CNCL_CMMSN_TRD_CD as string,
		TRADE_AS_OF_CD as string,
		PROCESSING_DT as timestamp,
		SRCE_TRAN_CD as string,
		LAST_UPDT_USER_CD as string,
		CURRBUSDTINT as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(Create_dt = currentTimestamp()) ~> GetCurrentdate
GetCurrentdate derive({Copy of TRANS_ACCT_HIST_CD} = TRANS_ACCT_HIST_CD,
		{Copy of TAG_TRAN_CD} = TAG_TRAN_CD,
		{Copy of SRCE_TRAN_CD} = SRCE_TRAN_CD,
		{Copy of CLIENT_NBR} = CLIENT_NBR,
		{Copy of CNCL_CMMSN_TRD_CD} = CNCL_CMMSN_TRD_CD,
		{Copy of LAST_UPDT_USER_CD} = LAST_UPDT_USER_CD,
		{Copy of CURRBUSDTINT} = CURRBUSDTINT,
		{Copy of TRANSACTION_DT} = toString(TRANSACTION_DT),
		{Copy of TRADE_AS_OF_CD} = TRADE_AS_OF_CD) ~> DataConversion
GetCurrentdate aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount10
DataConversion sink(input(
		client_nbr as string,
		last_updt_user_cd as string,
		processing_dt as string,
		cncl_cmmsn_trd_cd as string,
		tag_tran_cd as string,
		trade_as_of_cd as string,
		srce_tran_cd as string,
		transaction_dt as string,
		trade_dt as string,
		Create_Dt as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		currBusDtInt as string,
		trans_acct_hist_cd as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,batchSize: 1000000,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		client_nbr = {Copy of CLIENT_NBR},
		last_updt_user_cd = {Copy of LAST_UPDT_USER_CD},
		processing_dt = PROCESSING_DT,
		cncl_cmmsn_trd_cd = {Copy of CNCL_CMMSN_TRD_CD},
		tag_tran_cd = {Copy of TAG_TRAN_CD},
		trade_as_of_cd = {Copy of TRADE_AS_OF_CD},
		srce_tran_cd = {Copy of SRCE_TRAN_CD},
		transaction_dt = TRANSACTION_DT,
		trade_dt = TRADE_DT,
		Create_Dt = Create_dt,
		currBusDtInt = {Copy of CURRBUSDTINT},
		trans_acct_hist_cd = {Copy of TRANS_ACCT_HIST_CD}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount10 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCount1CACHESINK
